how-to-restore-dignity-to-the-world-of-w.precis: How to restore dignity to the world of work, according to The Guardian. Colin Montgomery suggests that expectations should be properly managed. Plus letters from Paul Hartley , Hartley Dean and Peter Thornton John Harris’s jeremiad about what the world of work has become ( A truism for our political leaders: until work again involves respect and decent levels of pay, this crisis will continue, 22 November ) put me in mind of the old joke: “How do I get to Dublin?” “Well, I wouldn’t start from here.” Because, as he concludes, there’s almost no chance of any government being able to even begin to relieve this situation quickly, short of putting an emergency brake on 40 years of neoliberalism.
